label: Index card and side picker
thesis: One act-tab index card, the site's own idiom, with the show picker opening beside it so the card stays in view while you tick shows.
risk: The card and picker side by side need width; on phones the picker must cover the card, so the desktop view is not the mobile view.

label: Split view, shows always visible
thesis: The act's shows sit beside the card with all ticked, so a right swipe is one step and no picker dialog is needed.
risk: Shows are visible before the visitor commits, so it feels more like a list than a swipe game; pre-ticking could save shows by accident.

label: Photo stack with bottom sheet
thesis: A big-photo card stack with peeking cards feels like a swipe game, and a bottom sheet holds the picker.
risk: Leans on photos many acts lack, departs from the text-first look, and gives the embedded player little room.
